podcast.body: This self-titled, vinyl-only demo was recorded in 1987 by Sons of Kyuss, featuring Josh Homme, Nick Oliveri, Brett Bjork, and John Garcia. Only five copies were pressed, showcasing a "big slab of sludge rock." "In 1987, sons of caes, Josh is buddy Nick Olivary, drummer Brett Bjork and singer John Garcia, recorded a demo, and the result was a self-titled vinyl-only release. Only five copies were pressed up. It was a big slab of sludge rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 1
